content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital paypal

Stripe and PayPal offer payment processing as a service. They handle transactions but retain ultimate control. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle bundle hosting, payments, and delivery — but still operate as middlemen. Your store lives on their infrastructure. They can suspend you, change terms, or exit your market without notice. Sovereign commerce stacks like COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) invert this model. You own the hosting (Cloudflare Pages), the backend logic (Cloudflare Workers), the order storage (Supabase), and the file delivery (Cloudflare R2). Payments are processed on-chain via NOWPayments (0.5% fee). No platform dependency. No single point of failure. Full data ownership from day one.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal exclude countries based on banking partnerships, regulatory risks, and currency volatility. Nigeria is blocked due to forex restrictions and perceived fraud risk. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle inherit these restrictions because they rely on Stripe/PayPal for payments. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely. Your store runs on global, permissionless infrastructure. Payments are accepted in 300+ cryptocurrencies via NOWPayments. No KYC. No buyer account required. Your customers pay in USDT, USDC, or SOL. You receive funds directly to your wallet. No intermediary can freeze your account or exit your market.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal process payments instantly but hold funds for 2–7 days. They charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. Crypto payments via NOWPayments confirm on-chain in 1–10 minutes (depending on network). The fee is 0.5%. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction costs under $0.10. Sovereign stacks have no platform fees. You pay $197 once for deployment. Hosting, backend logic, and storage remain free indefinitely. Your only ongoing cost is the 0.5% payment processing fee. Compare this to Gumroad’s 10% cut or Paddle’s 5% + $0.50 per sale.
Sovereign commerce is not a workaround — it’s base-layer infrastructure you own.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With Stripe/PayPal, you rent access to payment rails. With Gumroad/Paddle, you rent access to their entire stack. Sovereign commerce gives you ownership. Your store is deployed to your GitHub or Cloudflare account. Your backend logic runs on your Workers instance. Your orders are stored in your Supabase database. File delivery is handled via your R2 bucket. Automation is built into the stack. Payments trigger webhooks that update order status and deliver files instantly. COREMERCH configures this for you during deployment. After delivery, you own and control everything. No platform can shut you down or change your terms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you need a temporary workaround and can afford platform fees, Gumroad or Paddle might suffice. But if you’re building a business in a restricted market, sovereign infrastructure is the only permanent solution. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is designed for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other excluded regions. It’s pressure-tested against currency collapse, payment rejection, and financial isolation. Deploy once. Own forever. Sell globally without permission.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. COREMERCH handles deployment and configuration. You receive a fully operational store with 30-day support. No coding required.
What if crypto prices fluctuate?
Set prices in USD. Customers pay in stablecoins like USDT or USDC. You receive the exact USD value, regardless of crypto price movements.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually via your crypto wallet. The stack includes a refund request form customers can submit.
Can I sell physical products?
No. This stack is designed for digital products only. File delivery is automated via Cloudflare R2.
What happens after 30-day support ends?
You own and control everything. COREMERCH has no access. You can manage the stack yourself or hire a developer.
Deploy once. Own forever. No platform can shut you down or change your terms.
